zh: 宿主的「回到底部」按钮改到输入框上方的正中：它原先长在对话栏右缘，正好压在站在输入卡片上的吉祥物身上；按钮仍是宿主的那个，皮肤只挪位置。
en: The host's back-to-end button now sits centred above the composer. Its shipped place is the conversation column's right edge, which is where the mascot stands on the composer card; the button stays the host's own and only its placement is the skin's.
